case_applicability.assessment: VOSO4 x H2O identifies a hydrated vanadyl sulfate family but does not provide a CAS or explicit water count beyond potentially shorthand x. CHEBI87020 defines vanadyl sulfate hydrate with unspecified hydration, the scope of the existing variable-hydrate owner. It can serve as a broader family interpretation; it must not be asserted to be a verified monohydrate or the separate five-water compound.

VOSO4 x5H2O source277 matches primary CHEBI132758 vanadyl sulfate pentahydrate. The ontology contains both CAS12439-96-2 used by MediaDive and CAS14708-82-8 retained in the owner, so that CAS difference alone is not a contradiction. Its five-water formula distinguishes it from unspecified hydrate CHEBI87020 and supports the current exact-form identity for this source.
